title: A noise that does not impress
odia: କଂସାରୀ ଘର ପାରାଙ୍କୁ କୁଲା ଢାଉଁ ଢାଉଁ
literal_meaning: To the bell-metal worker’s household pigeons: bang, bang with a winnowing tray!
explanation: An attempt to startle or impress has little effect on someone already accustomed to the disturbance. The joke contrasts the small display of noise with the noisy workshop imagined around the birds. It can describe an empty threat made to an experienced listener.
meaning_odia: ଯିଏ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସେହିପରି ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ ଅଭ୍ୟସ୍ତ, ତାକୁ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଧମକ ବା ଆଡ଼ମ୍ବର ଦେଖାଇ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ କରିବାର ଚେଷ୍ଟା।
usage_example: A seasoned performer remains calm when someone tries to unsettle them with a little backstage commotion. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The workshop and winnowing tray form the saying’s acoustic image. Kansari is translated through the craft role in this expression; it does not establish the identity of any present maker or an inherited community trait.
